info.description:
unscheduled is a portfolio demonstration. Its customer is fictional, and public open source repositories stand in for the products of that customer. It is not affiliated with NIST, the NVD, CISA, FIRST, MITRE, ENISA or any vendor named in the data, and its values are not official scores. It is not for security, legal or regulatory decisions. It never files a report and never applies a patch: a person approves every plan and files every report. This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.

Every CVE the serving slice holds, with the source and the time each value became known; the state
of a CVE on any past day; its ruler events; the NVD backlog values; the stand in products and their
exposure; live matching of a CycloneDX or SPDX JSON SBOM; and the customer's legacy CSV. Every
response carries the statement and the data version. Every error is a problem document
(application/problem+json) whose type links to its explanation in docs/SPEC.md.

This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD. Advisory data from the GitHub Advisory Database, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://github.com/github/advisory-database).
